NETWORK.NAME: TardiveDyskinesia_F1_draft
NETWORK.PROPERTY: clinical_validity=none; reference tables are synthetic structural placeholders, not patient estimates
ordering_contract=child state fastest, last declared parent next, first parent slowest
gate=encounter.kind == followup AND tardive_dyskinesia effect status == present; absent yields not_applicable, not_assessed or missing yields needs_clarification
aims_rule=AIMS findings are measurement only; no AIMS total or regional cutoff establishes diagnosis or intervention in this draft

VARIABLE.NAME: MotorSeverity
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=TD motor severity (current, clinician-rated)
definition=Clinician rating of current TD motor manifestations as mild or moderate-or-severe; meaningful only when the follow-up effect status is present. No AIMS total or regional cutoff is used.
source=history-effects-v0.1-draft tardive_dyskinesia severity (awaiting_review) + docs/medical-docs/tardive-dyskinesia-criteria.md Research criteria (AIMS background only)
status=proposed_mapping_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: DisablingImpact
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=TD disabling impact (current, clinician-assessed)
definition=Clinician assessment of whether current TD is disabling, distinct from motor severity; mild motor signs may still be disabling. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-14 moderate to severe or disabling criterion; tardive-dyskinesia-criteria.md functional impact; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: MildTreatmentConsideration
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Reason to consider treatment of mild TD
definition=At least one assessed reason to consider treatment of mild TD: patient preference, associated impairment, or psychosocial impact. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-14 mild-TD consideration factors; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: AttributionContext
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=TD diagnostic and attribution context

definition=Whether persistent TD associated with antipsychotic exposure is assessed after movement-pattern, persistence, exposure, onset review and exclusion of alternative explanations; alternative_or_unresolved covers assessed differential or withdrawal-emergent course needing longitudinal reassessment. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=tardive-dyskinesia-criteria.md Diagnostic features + Differential diagnosis; STATEMENT-14 Implementation (withdrawal-emergent, spontaneous, workup); field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: DoseReductionLink
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Dose-reduction temporal link

definition=Dyskinesia began or increased around antipsychotic dose reduction; prompts longitudinal review up to several months, never an automatic waiting period or exclusion of persistent TD. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-14 Implementation dose-reduction paragraph; BN-14 DoseReductionTemporalLink drafting lead; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentDysphagiaConcern
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent dysphagia or constant-movement concern

definition=Clinician-identified urgent concern: constant movement with gagging/choking or breathing impact. Required input; missing blocks with needs_clarification and the deterministic flag never waits for inference. Proposed structured field, not collected.
source=STATEMENT-14 life-threatening circumstances paragraph; field proposed, not collected
status=missing_field_proposed_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: IndicationReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=TD indication review output
definition=Posterior over review prompts for VMAT2 discussion: recommended/consider/monitor/assess-diagnosis. Not a prescription, not a product choice, not a safety clearance.
source=proposed for review; STATEMENT-14 recommendation strength 1B applied only as review wording, never as a probability
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: LongitudinalReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Longitudinal course review output
definition=Parallel course review for withdrawal-emergent presentation; never delays urgent care or withholds indication review.
source=STATEMENT-14 Implementation longitudinal-course paragraph; proposed for review
status=proposed_output_for_review

VARIABLE.NAME: UrgentSafetyReview
VARIABLE.PROPERTY: label=Urgent safety review output
definition=Urgent concerns take priority regardless of diagnostic status; rendered from saved inputs alongside posteriors.
source=STATEMENT-14 life-threatening paragraph; proposed for review
status=proposed_output_for_review
